issues.detail: The Greek 'ου γαρ υπεστειλαμην' means 'for I have not hidden,' but the Vietnamese translation adds a negative 'không hề' (not at all/never) and structures it as 'không hề giấu giếm mà không rao báo' (not hiding but not announcing), which creates a double negative logic that slightly alters the flow of the Greek intended to say 'I have not hidden [it] in order not to announce...'
